title: Crafted Armors Trims
description: This simple datapack adds recipes for every armor trims in the game. It does not include the Netherite Upgrade.
body:
**_Crafted Armor Trims allows you to craft all armor trims in the game._**

### How it works:

The recipe consists of **8 diamonds** arranged around a **block related to the location where the armor trim is obtained**. 💎

![Rib armor trim craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/071b5325bcae9547eec458270595172f111d18c8.png)

### Block per trim:

The **Silence trim** is crafted with another trim, as it is usually more difficult to obtain.

### Datapack updates:

If this datapack reaches **100 downloads**, new improvements related to trims will be added!

**💡Recipes:** All recipes are available in the data pack gallery.
